description: This file defines a JSON formatter for the Logrus logging library, including customization options for timestamp format, HTML escaping, caller information, and JSON pretty printing. It implements the Format method to serialize log entries into JSON format.

classes.name: JSONFormatter
classes.description: A struct that formats log entries into JSON with customizable options.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Serializes a log entry into JSON format, applying formatting options and including caller information if available.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a fieldKey to its string representation, considering custom mappings.
